scenes.title: £1,319 a month from a 1-bed Airbnb in Jamaica
scenes.vo: One thousand three hundred and nineteen pounds a month. That's a typical one-bed Airbnb in Jamaica, gross, at sixty percent occupancy.
That's from a typical rate of seventy-two pounds a night, about ninety-seven US dollars, across over two and a half thousand one-beds.
One-beds make up almost half the listings we track, so expect competition.

scenes.desc: Typical asking price, 1-bed home in Jamaica
scenes.vo: A typical one-bed is listed at about a hundred and seventy thousand pounds, or two hundred and twenty-seven thousand US dollars.
That's before cleaning, fees and management.
Run your own numbers free with the APG Deal Analyser, in pounds, US dollars or Jamaican dollars. Link in my bio.
